name: XT Event Widget for Social Events
author: Xylus Themes

sections.description:
XT Event Widget for Social Events is the most powerful WordPress plugin for displaying Facebook events on your website. Whether you run a community page, a business, or a yoga studio — this plugin lets you create stunning, real-time event feeds in minutes.

🚀 No Facebook API Key Required! Our intelligent scraping engine fetches events directly — no app creation, no tokens, no hassle.

🔥 Upgrade to Pro | 📖 Documentation | 💬 Support

🎯 Live Feed Builder (New!)

Create and manage multiple event feeds with our intuitive visual builder:

  • Event IDs Source — Paste specific Facebook Event IDs to display selected events
  • iCal URL Source — Import events from any Facebook iCal/ICS export link
  • Facebook Page Source — Fetch all events from any public Facebook Page automatically (Pro)
  • Facebook Group Source — Fetch all events from any public Facebook Group automatically (Pro)

🎨 Beautiful Layouts

Choose from a variety of stunning, responsive layouts:

  • Card Grid — Modern, responsive grid cards with event images, dates, and venue info
  • List View — Clean, classic list layout for a traditional event listing
  • Timeline — Vertical chronological timeline with elegant date markers (Pro)
  • Compact List — Maximum event details packed into a space-saving design (Pro)
  • Minimal Grid — Sleek, minimalistic grid with subtle hover effects (Pro)
  • Ticket List — Specialized layout highlighting ticket info and event dates (Pro)
  • Masonry — Dynamic, Pinterest-style staggered grid layout (Pro)

⚙️ Powerful Features

  • Gutenberg Block — Embed event feeds directly from the WordPress Block Editor
  • Advanced Date Filters — Show today’s, this week’s, this month’s, upcoming, or custom date range events
  • Hide Online Events — Filter out virtual/online events from your feed
  • Configurable Pagination — AJAX load-more or numbered pagination with customizable events per page
  • Smart Caching — Set your own cache duration (minutes) to balance freshness vs. performance
  • Auto Background Sync — Events and HQ images are fetched in the background without slowing down your page
  • High-Quality Images — Automatically fetches full-resolution cover photos for every event
  • Location & Venue Data — Displays venue name, address, and coordinates scraped from Facebook
  • Organizer Details — Shows event creator/organizer name with link
  • Responsive Design — Looks great on desktop, tablet, and mobile
  • Custom CSS — Add your own CSS per feed for full design control
  • Shortcode Support — Use [xtfeprofeed id="FEED_ID"] anywhere on your site
  • Legacy Widget Support — Classic WordPress widget for sidebars and footers
  • Legacy Shortcode — [wpfb_events page_id="YOUR_PAGE_ID" max_events="10"] still supported (Pro)

🔌 Facebook Embeddable Page Widget

Two easy ways to display Facebook’s official embeddable page widget:

  • Shortcode: [fb_event_widget page_url="https://www.facebook.com/redbull/" width="340" height="500" hide_cover="false" hide_cta="true" small_header="true"]
  • WP Widget: Use the “Facebook Page Event Widget” from the WordPress widget area

🔑 Facebook App Authentication (Optional)

For the legacy widget that uses the official Facebook Graph API:

  • Connect your Facebook account with one click — no manual app creation needed
  • Or create your own Facebook App for full control (How to create a Facebook App)
  • Your site must use HTTPS (SSL certificate)

⭐ Pro Features

Unlock the full potential with XT Facebook Events Pro:

  • Facebook Page Source — Automatically scrape all events from any public Facebook Page
  • Facebook Group Source — Automatically scrape all events from any public Facebook Group
  • 5 Additional Layouts — Timeline, Compact List, Minimal Grid, Ticket List, and Masonry
  • Legacy Grid Shortcode — Beautiful responsive event grid via shortcode
  • Gutenberg Block Shortcode — Enhanced block editor support
  • Activity Logs — Track all API calls, image fetches, and errors in a detailed log viewer
  • License & Updates — Automatic updates and priority support
  • Background Pagination — Silently fetches all event pages in the background for large event lists

👉 Get Pro Now

🔗 Our Other Plugins

  • WP Bulk Delete — Delete posts, pages, comments, users, taxonomy terms, and meta fields in bulk using powerful filters and conditions.
  • Easy Events Calendar — Create and manage events with ease using a simple and powerful WordPress event calendar.
  • WP Event Aggregator — Import Facebook, Eventbrite, Meetup, iCalendar (ICS), and other event sources into your WordPress Event Calendar.
  • Import Social Events — Import Facebook events into your WordPress website or event calendar with beautiful shortcode and widget displays.
  • Import Eventbrite Events — Import Eventbrite events into your WordPress website or event calendar with shortcode and widget support.
  • Import Meetup Events — Import Meetup.com events into your WordPress website effortlessly.
  • Event Schema / Structured Data — Automatically generate JSON-LD Event Schema markup for Google Rich Results and improved SEO.
  • WP Smart Import — Import CSV files into WordPress posts, pages, and custom post types with advanced mapping options.
  • XT Feed for LinkedIn — Automatically share WordPress posts to LinkedIn and expand your content reach with one click.
sections.installation:
Install from WordPress Dashboard

  1. Log in and navigate to Plugins → Add New.
  2. Search for “XT Widget for Facebook Events”.
  3. Click “Install Now” and then “Activate”.
  4. Go to Facebook Events → Live Feeds to create your first event feed.

Manual Installation

  1. Download the plugin from WordPress.org.
  2. Unzip and upload the xt-facebook-events folder to /wp-content/plugins/.
  3. Activate the plugin from the Plugins screen.
  4. Navigate to Facebook Events → Live Feeds to get started.

Quick Start

  1. Click “Add New Feed” from the Live Feeds page.
  2. Choose your event source (Event IDs, iCal URL, or Page/Group ID with Pro).
  3. Select a layout and configure display settings.
  4. Publish the feed and copy the shortcode or use the Gutenberg block.
sections.faq:
Do I need a Facebook API key?

No! The Live Feed Builder uses an intelligent scraping engine that works without any API keys or Facebook app setup. The legacy widget method still supports optional Facebook App authentication.

What event sources are supported?

The free version supports Event IDs and iCal URL sources. The Pro version adds Facebook Page ID and Facebook Group ID sources for automatic event fetching.

Can I display events from a Facebook Group?

Yes, but this requires the Pro add-on. With Pro, simply paste your Group URL or ID and the plugin will automatically fetch all upcoming events.

How many layouts are available?

The free version includes Card Grid and List View. The Pro version adds Timeline, Compact List, Minimal Grid, Ticket List, and Masonry layouts — 7 layouts total.

Will events update automatically?

Yes! Events are cached for the duration you configure (default: 24 hours). When the cache expires, fresh events are fetched automatically. You can also manually clear the cache from the feed settings.

Does it work with Gutenberg?

Absolutely! Use the XT Facebook Events Feed block to embed any feed directly in the block editor with a simple dropdown selector.

Can I hide online/virtual events?

Yes. Each feed has a “Hide Online Events” toggle in the Filters tab that automatically detects and hides virtual events (including multi-language detection).

Is the plugin GDPR compliant?

The plugin fetches public event data from Facebook and caches it on your server. No user tracking or third-party cookies are used. Event data is displayed directly from your WordPress database cache.
